title.en: Tell symmetric, positively and negatively skewed curves apart
Compute Karl Pearson's coefficient of skewness

say.en: Most families in a town earn modest incomes, a few earn a lot. The income curve has a long tail on the right. Skewness measures this lack of symmetry. In this lesson: Tell symmetric, positively and negatively skewed curves apart.
Compute Karl Pearson's coefficient of skewness.

body.en: *Skewness* means lack of symmetry. In a symmetric distribution mean = median = mode. If the right tail is longer, the distribution is positively skewed and mean > median > mode; if the left tail is longer, it is negatively skewed and mean < median < mode. Karl Pearson's coefficient is $Sk_P = (\bar{x} - Mo)/\sigma$, or $3(\bar{x} - Md)/\sigma$ when the mode is ill-defined.
body.kn: ವಕ್ರತೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಮಮಿತಿಯ ಕೊರತೆ. ಸಮಮಿತ ವಿತರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಾಸರಿ = ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ = ಬಹುಲಕ. ಬಲ ಬಾಲ ಉದ್ದವಾದರೆ ಧನ ವಕ್ರತೆ: ಸರಾಸರಿ > ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ > ಬಹುಲಕ. ಎಡ ಬಾಲ ಉದ್ದವಾದರೆ ಋಣ ವಕ್ರತೆ. ಕಾರ್ಲ್ ಪಿಯರ್ಸನ್ ಗುಣಾಂಕ = (ಸರಾಸರಿ − ಬಹುಲಕ)/σ ಅಥವಾ 3(ಸರಾಸರಿ − ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ)/σ.

say.en: Skewness means lack of symmetry. In a symmetric distribution mean equals median equals mode. If the right tail is longer, the distribution is positively skewed and mean is greater than median is greater than mode; if the left tail is longer, it is negatively skewed and mean is less than median is less than mode. Karl Pearson's coefficient is Sk P equals (\bar{x} - Mo)/\sigma, or 3(\bar{x} - Md)/\sigma when the mode is ill-defined. Symmetric: Sk equals 0.
say.kn: ವಕ್ರತೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಮಮಿತಿಯ ಕೊರತೆ. ಸಮಮಿತ ವಿತರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಾಸರಿ = ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ equals ಬಹುಲಕ. ಬಲ ಬಾಲ ಉದ್ದವಾದರೆ ಧನ ವಕ್ರತೆ: ಸರಾಸರಿ is greater than ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ is greater than ಬಹುಲಕ. ಎಡ ಬಾಲ ಉದ್ದವಾದರೆ ಋಣ ವಕ್ರತೆ. ಕಾರ್ಲ್ ಪಿಯರ್ಸನ್ ಗುಣಾಂಕ equals (ಸರಾಸರಿ - ಬಹುಲಕ)/ sigma ಅಥವಾ 3(ಸರಾಸರಿ - ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ)/ sigma.

say.en: Positive skew: tail to the right.
Empirical relation: Mode is approximately 3 Median minus 2 Mean.
A symmetric curve: mean, median and mode sit together at the centre.
Positive skew: a long tail to the right. The mode is at the peak, the median next, and the mean is pulled furthest right.
Negative skew is the mirror image: the long tail is on the left and the mean is the smallest.
Pearson measures how far the mean has been dragged from the mode, in units of sigma.
On the board: Three shapes.

title.en: Mean, median and mode pull apart

narration.en: Increase the skewness: the long tail drags the mean furthest, the median follows part of the way, and the mode stays at the peak. With a right tail, mean > median > mode; flip it and the order reverses. Karl Pearson's coefficient (mean − mode)/σ takes the sign of the tail.

problem.en: Mean = 45, mode = 40, S.D. = 10. Find Karl Pearson's coefficient of skewness and comment.

steps.en: Positive, so the tail is to the right.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Mean = 45, mode = 40, S.D. = 10. Find Karl Pearson's coefficient of skewness and comment.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Mean equals 45, mode equals 40, S.D. = 10. Find Karl Pearson's coefficient of skewness and comment.
Sk equals (mean - mode)/ sigma.
Sk equals 45 minus 40/10 equals 0.5.
Positive, so the tail is to the right.
So the answer is Sk equals 0.5, moderately positively skewed.

problem.en: Mean = 60, median = 63, S.D. = 9 (mode ill-defined). Find the coefficient of skewness.

steps.en: Negative: longer tail to the left.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Mean = 60, median = 63, S.D. = 9 (mode ill-defined). Find the coefficient of skewness.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Mean equals 60, median equals 63, S.D. = 9 (mode ill-defined). Find the coefficient of skewness.
Use Sk equals 3(mean - median)/ sigma.
Sk equals 360 minus 63/9 equals minus 9 over 9 equals minus 1.
Negative: longer tail to the left.
So the answer is Sk equals minus 1, negatively skewed.

body.en: The mean is pulled towards the long tail, the mode stays at the peak, and the median sits in between. So the sign of mean − mode is the sign of skewness.
